request.initial_prompt: Prospero. This blue-eyed hag was hither brought with child And here was left by the sailors. Thou, my slave, As thou report'st thyself, wast then her servant; And, for thou wast a spirit too delicate To act her earthy and abhorr'd commands, Refusing her grand hests, she did confine thee, By help of her more potent ministers And in her most unmitigable rage, Into a cloven pine; within which rift Imprison'd thou didst painfully remain A dozen years; within which space she died And left thee there; where thou didst vent thy groans As fast as mill-wheels strike. Then was this island-- Save for the son that she did litter here, A freckled whelp hag-born--not honour'd with A human shape.

raw_segments.text: Prospero, This blue-eyed hag was hither brought With child, and here was left by the sailors.
Thou, my slave, As thou report'st thyself, wast then her servant,
And for thou wast a spirit too delicate To act her earthy and abhorr'd commands,
Refusing her grand hests, she did confine thee, By help of her more potent ministers,
And in her most unmitigable rage, Into a cloven pine,
Within which rift Imprison'd thou didst painfully remain A dozen years,
Within which space she died And left thee there,
Where thou didst vent thy groans As fast as mill-wheels strike.
Then was this island save For the son that she did litter here,
A freckled whelp hag-born not honoured With a human shape.
